title: RG-005: year 4 alone, from the original's files for the year before

source.experiment: stars-oracle-apparatus evidence/rg005 (private); start from year 2465 of the unrecorded RG5 warm-up

cases.setup: year 4 alone (NOT from game start. A new game (medium, normal density, farther positions, public scores, galaxy clumping, random events on) of five custom races, every player made an expert computer player and every pair set to enemies before the first year (a state edit, experiments/rg005); 65 years then generated unrecorded with the host planning (the warm-up; W = 65 by the pre-registered rule), and the recorded chain starts from that state. Each recorded year: the computer players planned from the current files, then the year was generated with every order file supplied, so the host ran no computer player and the stream starts at seeding)
cases.verdict: recorded under the pre-run record experiments/rg005/PREDICTION.md, which makes no per-case prediction; samples flagged from 2 other streams
